findings.title: Include alignment for the Mozilla box fallback
findings.body: The flexbox mixins explicitly support older Firefox through `display: -moz-box` and `display: -moz-inline-box`, but `align-items` does not emit the corresponding `-moz-box-align` property. Firefox versions using that fallback ignore the other alignment declarations, so the newly converted header and small-action rows use the default stretch alignment instead of centering their children, and bullet badges do not receive baseline alignment. Add `-moz-box-align: $alignment` so the advertised fallback preserves the intended layout.
